cadence.note: GitHub Actions scheduling is best-effort: 5 min minimum, routinely delayed 10-30 min, occasionally skipped. The real gap between runs is recorded on every entry so the timeline never implies precision it does not have.

notes: Paper money. No broker connection exists and none is planned. Thresholds are computed per run (bot/dynamic.py), not configured here; only risk RAILS are settings. The hold and cost rails come from a 12-year non-overlapping replay: at 1-day holds SPY nets -18.9% annualised after costs, at 60-day holds +14.0%. Cost tier decides the sign, holding period amplifies it.
